answer: Tie eligibility to rotating hardware-fault diagnosis. Each identity locks 39 POA and analyzes five randomly assigned telemetry traces per epoch for 13 epochs. A pulse beacon hides device models until commitment; six of nine auditors replay faults on independent rigs. A willow signature binds each trace to one credit, while a mirror hash merges copied diagnoses. N aliases need 5N original analyses and lock 39N POA; two false diagnoses burn each bond.
